findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment: 1st REPEAT: Light was visible along the right side of the emergency exit door where a slight gap was present. Provide repairs to outer openings.
findings.citation_text: 6-202.15 Outer openings of a food establishment  shall be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by; (1) Filling or closing holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings; (2) Closed, tight-fitting windows; and (3) Solid, self-closing, tight-fitting doors. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment: 1st REPEAT: Floor seam in women's restroom along the far wall had a gap that needs to be sealed. At previous inspections, this area of the floor was observed with an accumulation of debris. The floor was observed to be overall clean, including the seam. However, the area needs to be sealed to eliminate the gap and prevent future accumulation of debris.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 & 6-501.12 Physical facilities shall be maintained in good repair, and cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. [C]

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.citation_text:
3-202.15 A can of severely dented tuna (5oz Star Kist) was stocked and available for sale. Can was removed from sales floor. Ensure cans dented along seams or with severe dents on any surface are not stocked and available for purchase.
Food packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the food is not exposed to adulteration or potential contaminants.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.citation_text:
6-202.15 1. Light was visible along the right side of the emergency exit door where a slight gap was present.
2. Hole was observed in the weather stripping at the bottom of the main entrance doors. 
Provide repairs to outer openings. 
Outer openings of a food establishment  shall be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by; (1) Filling or closing holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings; (2) Closed, tight-fitting windows; and (3) Solid, self-closing, tight-fitting doors.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-501.11 & 6-501.12 1. Floor seam in women's restroom along the far wall had a gap that needs to be sealed. At previous inspections, this area of the floor was observed with an accumulation of debris. The floor was observed to be overall clean, including the seam. However, the area needs to be sealed to eliminate the gap and prevent future accumulation of debris. 
2. Rodent droppings were observed on the ledge of the wall access panel in the men’s restroom. Store manager was aware of the issue and stated there were plans to clean the area in question (see General Comments for additional information).
Physical facilities shall be maintained in good repair, and cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.citation_text:
3-302.11 Packages of fully cooked bacon were observed in the cooler below and next to packages of raw bacon. Fully cooked product was relocated to another shelf with cooked sausage to allow for storage away from raw foods.
Food shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display by separating raw animal foods from ready to eat foods.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text:
4-602.13 Dairy cooler shelving and surfaces on/around doors were soiled with splash and general buildup in the milk section. Mold was observed on the lower slatted shelving as well. 
-Shelving was soiled with mold and general buildup in the Fresh Food cooler located in the back storage room. 
Nonfood contact surfaces shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to eliminate buildup of grease, food splash and general debris.

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, & cleaned
findings.comment:
5-501.17 Women's restroom was observed without a lid on the garbage can. Men's room had a covered garbage can. The waste receptacles were switched so the covered garbage can was located in the women's room.
A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.18 Men's room toilet was observed soiled with general buildup on the outer surfaces between the seat and the floor. Clean all surfaces of restroom plumbing fixtures daily/as needed to eliminate buildup. 
Plumbing fixtures such as handwashing sinks, toilets, and urinals shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11 & 6-501.12 Ventilation covers in the ceilings of both restrooms were coated with dust buildup. This was also noted during the last routine inspection conducted in January 2018. Ensure cleaning as needed, and keep the aforementioned surface clean in both restrooms.
-Floor in both restrooms was soiled with dead bugs around the toilets and along walls. Clean the floor in both restrooms.
-Floor in the hallway between the restrooms was soiled with general debris accumulation under the water fountains where a push broom was stored. Remove debris from the floor after sweeping.
-Floor seam in women's room along the far wall had gaps were debris was accumulating. Clean the debris out of the floor seam and seal the seam to eliminate debris accumulation.
Physical facilities shall be maintained in good repair, and cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.16 Partially damp mop was observed in a mop bucket in the hallway between the restrooms. Store mops to allow for proper drying between uses. 
After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.citation_text:
750.140 (a) - Thermometer was not present in the dairy cooler. Store manager placed a new thermometer in the cooler during the inspection. 

All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
(R) 750.800e - Dairy cooler shelving was soiled with mold accumulation along edges and crevices and under the whipped topping and crescent roll shelf. Clean the shelves as needed, and maintain them clean.

Clean general surfaces, including inside all coolers and freezers, as needed to eliminate buildup of mold, splash, and general debris.

findings.title: Water source safe, hot, and cooled under pressure
findings.citation_text:
750.1120 - Hot water was not available at the restroom handsinks. Store manager stated an element probably burnt out after water pipes froze up in the restrooms recently. Restroom handsinks are on a different water heater than the mopsink, which had both hot and cold water at the time of inspection. Manager noted he cannot access the water heater, and a service call has to be placed with maintenance for repairs. (See General Comments) 

Each lavatory shall be provided with hot and cold water tempered by means of a mixing valve or combination faucet.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
(R) 750.1120 - Women's toilet room did not have a covered garbage can. Provide a covered garbage can.

All restrooms must have self-closing doors, properly operating fixtures, be clean and have proper hand washing supplies in order to help facilitate good hygienic practices.  Provide properly designed and maintained restrooms.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
(R) 750.1220 - Old glue board was observed behind women's room toilet. The glue board was coated with dead bugs. Discard the glue board in question, and replace glue boards frequently/as needed as they accumulate insects and general debris.

Floors shall be kept clean.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text:
750.1220 - Ventilation covers in the ceilings of both restrooms were coated with dust buildup. Clean the vent covers as needed to eliminate buildup.

Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean.
